title: Enable Change to Achieve the Envisioned Future State
coreMove: Change enablement turns a deliverable into sustained value by making teams protect adoption, transition, and the future state when pressure tempts them to defend only the baseline.

exampleSpecs.audience: project leads preparing stakeholder launch meetings
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a principle changes adoption work or stays on a slide
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show two leads using the same PMI 12-principle material with opposite results

exampleSpecs.stakes: a transition handoff may be cut to keep the baseline date
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a peer reframes the schedule-pressure choice so transition cannot be hidden

exampleSpecs.audience: new project coordinators learning the principle set
exampleSpecs.stakes: a learner confuses memorization with application
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use the learner's confusion to distinguish principle recall from adoption planning

exampleSpecs.stakes: green schedule reporting may hide an unsupported operating transition
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show the same review before and after the adoption tradeoff check

exampleSpecs.stakes: support records may reveal the real transition failure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: find the telling detail in existing files rather than stage a new event

exampleSpecs.audience: project leads making final go-live recommendations
exampleSpecs.stakes: a leader must sort through pressure without external dialogue
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: keep the scene inside one person's thoughts while the PMI principle tests the go-live call
